sql: with c as (select split_part(event_ticker,'-',1) as series, split_part(event_ticker,'-',2) as contest, close_time from mmsell_settlement_meta where event_ticker ~ '^KX(MLB|NFL|NCAAF|WNBA|EPL|ATP|WTA|ITF)' and close_time > now() - interval '20 days') select contest, count(*) markets, count(distinct series) series_n, count(distinct close_time) close_times, count(distinct (close_time at time zone 'UTC')::date) utc_dates, min(close_time) mn, max(close_time) mx from c group by 1 order by utc_dates desc, markets desc limit 20
